messages:
Mina: Quick bring-up notes for Quartz-11b quant/latency sweep against GTN longform and short-answer slices. Posting topline + routing recs.
Diego: nice, numbers?
Mina: small n=1k per slice. Short-answer F1 (exact-match-ish): fp16 72.4, int8 71.8 (-0.6), int6 70.1 (-2.3). Longform ROUGE-L: fp16 57.6, int8 56.9 (-0.7), int6 54.8 (-2.8). Cost per 1k tokens: fp16 $0.0217, int8 $0.0165, int6 $0.0120. p95 latency: fp16 baseline, int8 +5ms, int6 +11ms.
Sam: Ok so int8 looks like best cost/quality tradeoff. Int6 too risky for longform. Any slice-level exceptions?
Mina: Yeah: conversational multi-turn summaries and OCR-heavy docs show larger int6 drops (~3.5-4 ROUGE-L). Short Q&A mostly fine on int8.
Rachel: Product: we can tolerate up to ~1pt ROUGE-L drop on background tasks; user-visible summaries must stay within 0.5. So int8 still borderline for some summaries.
Mina: My recommendation: default -> quartz-11b-int8 for most user flows; route high-fidelity summaries and multi-turn chat to quartz-11b-fp16. Use quartz-11b-int6 only for archival/batch exports. Keep a 4% fp16 holdback and run a 1% int6 canary on non-critical endpoints for 72h.
Sam: Nice. Can we express routing snippet for infra?
Mina: routing example:
```
routes:
  - match: {endpoint: '/chat/summary', priority: 'high'}
    model: quartz-11b-fp16
  - match: {endpoint: '/chat/summary', priority: 'normal'}
    model: quartz-11b-int8
  - match: {endpoint: '/export/archive'}
    model: quartz-11b-int6
  - holdback: 4% -> quartz-11b-fp16
  - canary: 1% -> quartz-11b-int6 (72h)
```
Diego: Ops: can you generate expected daily savings for GTN baseline (estimate 8M tokens/day) if 30% of traffic moves to int8 vs fp16?
Sam: Quick calc: 8M * 30% * (0.0217-0.0165)/1000 ≈ $12.48/day saved. If 20% moves to int6 instead, additional savings ≈ 8M * 20% * (0.0165-0.0120)/1000 ≈ $6.0/day.
canary-bot: canary-rollout created: quartz-11b-int6 1% non-critical (2026-03-23T16:12:08Z)
Rachel: I'll brief PMs with the scorecard bullets and ask if they want a stricter holdback for summaries. Thanks team.
Mina: I'll upload per-slice charts and add alert if any slice sees >1.0 ROUGE-L drop vs fp16 or >1.5% F1 drop for short-answer. Ping me if alerts fire.
Diego: SGTM, follow up sync in 24h.
